title: Upskilling or deskilling? Measurable role of an AI-supported training for radiology residents: a lesson from the pandemic.
summary: Controlled pilot with eight residents and 150 CXRs found improved accuracy and error resilience with AI-supported training; limited to short-term simulated reading. The bibliographic records retrieved do not state an author affiliation.
